links.comparator_used: Predefined trial-level eligibility threshold of 0.40 versus a lower threshold of 0.13 chosen to maximize sensitivity
links.outcome: Trial-level eligibility sensitivity, specificity, PPV and NPV
links.effect: At 0.40: sensitivity 78.3%, specificity 98.5%, PPV 92.6%, NPV 94.8%. At 0.13: sensitivity 98.7%, specificity 97.6%, PPV 91.2%, NPV 99.7%.
links.tradeoff: The lower threshold slightly reduced specificity (98.5% to 97.6%) and PPV (92.6% to 91.2%).
links.quote: A lower threshold (0.13) maximized sensitivity (98.7%), while maintaining high specificity at 97.6%, PPV at 91.2%, and NPV at 99.7%.
